name: monday-sync
description: Keeps the monday.com Software Engineering board in sync with agent-isdd and git, and auto-drafts specs for tickets moved to Gather Requirements.

shared_memory_root.title: Shared memory root
shared_memory_root.description: Optional. The same shared memory root agent-isdd uses. When set, monday-sync scans <dir>/sdd-memory/*/spec/ at session start for linked features whose workflow-state.md changed since the last board sync, and resolves Bash edits to features by slug.
